description: This file is a shell script for testing the compatibility of object formats in Git repositories. It defines functions and executes commands to initialize repositories with different object formats (sha1 and sha256), create various Git objects (commits, trees, tags, blobs), sign objects, and verify that object transformations and signatures are consistent across formats.

methods.name: compat_hash
methods.description: Returns the alternate hash algorithm for a given hash (sha1 <-> sha256).

methods.name: hello_oid
methods.description: Retrieves the object id for a 'hello' blob based on hash algorithm.

methods.name: tree_oid
methods.description: Retrieves the object id for a tree object based on hash algorithm.

methods.name: commit_oid
methods.description: Retrieves the object id for a commit object based on hash algorithm.

methods.name: commit2_oid
methods.description: Retrieves the object id for a second commit object based on hash algorithm.

methods.name: del_sigcommit
methods.description: Deletes the signature from a commit object.

methods.name: del_sigtag
methods.description: Deletes the signature from a tag object.

methods.name: compare_oids
methods.description: Performs comprehensive comparisons and consistency checks between object representations across sha1 and sha256 repositories.
